formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: Parts always add to the balance (linked: residual rules src/domain/assets/index.ts:1558-1595; hand-built: src/domain/assets/index.ts:1510-1541). Overdrawn hand-built account with recorded cash: cash = min(cash, max(0, balance)) = $0 (src/domain/assets/index.ts:1533) and the whole negative balance is filed under the account's own class (src/domain/assets/index.ts:1539). Unpriced holdings take the residual under their class, or Unclassified across classes, never cash (src/domain/assets/index.ts:1560-1566).
formula_checks.card_text_says: Cash 'above zero, never more than the balance'; the parts always add up to the balance. Says nothing about a negative balance.
formula_checks.plain_example: Hand-built brokerage, balance −$100, recorded cash $50 → Cash $0, Unclassified −$100 (total −$100). Ruling needed: refuse/flag the account, or keep it as built.

formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: TREASURY_RE = treasur…|treas|ust|t-bill|t-note|t-bond|govt|government (src/domain/assets/index.ts:1602); classPortionLabel counts any bond holding whose name has 'government' or 'govt' as a Treasury (src/domain/assets/index.ts:1679).
formula_checks.card_text_says: Treasury words include 'government' — card and code agree.
formula_checks.plain_example: Holdings 'US Government Agency 2032' and 'Municipal bond 2030' → '1 Treasury & 1 bond in this account'. An agency bond is not a US Treasury, and DEC-3035g names only TREAS, UST, T-bond (and T-bill wording) → should read '2 bonds in this account'. The card text changes with the fix. (The case itself stays UNCLEAR: no decision names 'government' either way; CODE WRONG here rests on the fact that an agency bond is not a Treasury.)

formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: An account with no balance adds nothing to any class ((a.balance || 0), src/domain/assets/index.ts:1743); the same screen's amber box names it — dataGaps 'no-balance': 'X has no balance … left out of your totals … not counted as $0' (src/domain/gaps/index.ts:166-175; NetWorthScreen.tsx calls dataGaps).
formula_checks.card_text_says: The seven classes add to everything owned; silent on a missing balance.
formula_checks.plain_example: Brokerage with no balance + checking $1,000 → Cash $1,000, every other class $0; Net worth's amber box says 'Brokerage has no balance'. That is the ruled behaviour (left out, named), not a silent $0.

formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: Handed the household's home and car, correct. Told nothing: every property with no stated use is 0% (src/domain/assets/index.ts:1806) and no vehicle is the car driven, so every car is 100% (src/domain/assets/index.ts:1808 never matches). Callers that tell it nothing: src/screens/RetirementCockpit.tsx:161,165,173,672,673,959 (the Plan donut and rows), src/domain/decumulation/index.ts:43, src/domain/assets/index.ts:185-192 (portfolioActualReturn), src/domain/assets/index.ts:2172 (earmarkedKinds).
formula_checks.card_text_says: 'told nothing, a property stated as the home lived in, or with no use stated, is 0%' — the card describes the code; both contradict DEC-2747e for a second property.
formula_checks.plain_example: Household: house A (entered first) $300,000, house B $200,000, no uses stated, car $30,000. Retirement total (told the household) = $200,000 — right. Plan donut (told nothing) counts $30,000 (the car driven at 100%) and $0 for B → should be $200,000 and $0 for the car.

Not reachable from the Itemize screen today: a holding needs a value above 0 to be added (src/screens/ItemizeScreen.tsx:72).

formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: Name evidence first (src/domain/assets/reclassify.ts:46-47), then a maturity date (48), money-market kind (49), CD kind (50). No property-name guard and no confirmation check inside the function; the only guard is in its caller, which skips an account with wrapper_confirmed (reclassify.ts:99). wrapper_confirmed records that the person confirmed the account's TYPE (kind / tax bucket — ingest.ts:385, useStore.ts:782); a class picked in the Net worth editor sets asset_class and no flag (NetWorthScreen.tsx:1155-1165). assetClassOf already does maturity-before-name and skips property names (index.ts:519-525); correctClassOf does not.
formula_checks.card_text_says: 'the class its name is evidence for; else Bonds & CDs if it has a maturity date; …' — the card describes the code, so it carries the same wrong order.
formula_checks.plain_example: (1) Maturity does NOT beat the name: 'Ally Money Market CD', maturing 2027-06-30, stored Bonds & CDs → correctClassOf Stocks / Funds and the sweep re-files it (proof run) → should stay Bonds & CDs. (The auditor's 'Savings' example passes: 'Savings' is no name evidence.) (2) Property name read: home 'Silver Creek land' (Real estate) → Alternatives → should be no correction ('Silver Lake house' is safe only because 'house' is a dwelling word). (3) Confirmed class: preserved only for a wrapper_confirmed account (proof: 'CD Fund' confirmed stays Stocks / Funds); an editor-picked class ('CD 2030 ladder' set to Stocks / Funds) is re-filed to Bonds & CDs. Exposure: the sweep runs once per device (useStore.ts:986-990).

formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: A confirmed account is left whole (reclassify.ts:99 — holds DEC-2748h). For each holding: name evidence for bonds → 'bond', for ANY other non-cash class → 'stock_etf' (reclassify.ts:110-113), with no check of class_source 'user' (the person's own answer, src/domain/performance/index.ts:23). So Alternatives evidence (gold, crypto, options) is written as Stocks / Funds, and a person's answer is overwritten whenever the name disagrees.
formula_checks.card_text_says: 'if its name is evidence for bonds it becomes a bond; if for any other class except cash, a stock or fund' — the card describes the code.
formula_checks.plain_example: Does a Gold holding become Stocks / Funds? Its STORED class, yes: 'Gold' stored Alternatives → 'stock_etf', 1 change (proof run). For a holding nobody classed the screens still show Alternatives, because holdingClassOf reads the name before the stored tag (index.ts:1427-1428). For a Gold holding the PERSON classed Alternatives (class_source 'user') the sweep writes Stocks / Funds and holdingClassOf then files it Stocks / Funds everywhere (index.ts:1425) → should stay Alternatives, 0 changes. Same for a person's Stocks / Funds on 'Treasury ETF' → re-filed Bonds & CDs.

coverage: 130 of 130 cases run (129 executed, 1 skipped as BLOCKED); 109 PASS, 7 FINDING, 3 BRIEF_WRONG, 10 UNCLEAR, 1 BLOCKED. Formula checks: 15 of 15 non-RIGHT checks classified (11 RIGHT not repeated).
